validation_requirements: Fail closed if input hashes or expected old node count/value mismatch
Exactly one root cust_features/cust_feature block and no duplicate changed names
Output name map must differ by only six specified edits: four adds, one removal, one scalar replacement
All other XML nodes and attributes must remain semantically identical; preferably preserve formatting by exact element replacement
Preserve target UID/GID 0:0,0644 and security.selinux u:object_r:system_file:s0 bytes from target metadata
After image rebuild, extract this file and verify planned output hash and metadata
This is static configuration alignment, not a boot/thermal/RF certification
unresolved: Five donor thermal flags have no exact literal consumer in inspected donor APK/framework/native assets or three stock vendor native samples; omission from scan does not prove unused
Donor-only haptic BCL,audiozoom_device_type,charging,touch,RF boost,FFU/eSIM and other hardware-adjacent gates remain unchanged by this narrow policy; compatibility is not established
Donor common cust_features.xml still contains device-affecting features; do not describe this narrow patch as a complete device-feature transplant
